format: jinja2 template with Triton kernel code
description: This file contains Jinja2 templated Triton kernel functions for PyTorch's _inductor module, specifically for common GPU kernel operations related to attention mechanisms, including forward_block_mn and forward_inner functions.

methods.name: forward_block_mn
methods.description: A Triton kernel for processing a block of attention scores and updating accumulators, handling loading of K and V tensors, score computation, masking, and scaling.

methods.name: forward_inner
methods.description: A Triton kernel that iterates over blocks for sparse attention, calling forward_block_mn, managing offsets, and accumulating results.
